description: This file implements a PerHost proxy dialer in Go, which directs network connections to different dialers based on host-specific rules, including IP ranges, hostnames, and zones.

classes.name: PerHost
classes.description: A proxy dialer that routes connections based on host-specific rules.

methods.name: NewPerHost
methods.description: Creates a new PerHost dialer with default and bypass dialers.

methods.name: Dial
methods.description: Connects to an address using the appropriate dialer based on host rules.

methods.name: DialContext
methods.description: Connects to an address with context support, choosing the dialer based on host rules.

methods.name: dialerForRequest
methods.description: Determines which dialer to use for a given host.

methods.name: AddFromString
methods.description: Parses a comma-separated string to add hosts/IPs/zones for bypass.

methods.name: AddIP
methods.description: Adds a specific IP address to bypass list.

methods.name: AddNetwork
methods.description: Adds an IP network range to bypass list.

methods.name: AddZone
methods.description: Adds a DNS zone suffix to bypass list.

methods.name: AddHost
methods.description: Adds a hostname to bypass list.
